items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: But anyway, Huey Moore, Huey Moore's place, studio, had a studio there.

ctx.x: No, it was past Jackson. And what was his name, the man who had the record company?

What the lady name was kind of crippled, had to hit records in the 50s, the black lady. was kind of crippled, had the hit records in the 50s, the black lady. Oh, I'm gonna think, I'm gonna have to think, they're gonna come to me. But anyway, in Mississippi, past Jackson, they have a college there. It's an old, old, I think a later college. Well anyway, this recording studio was down the street from this college. And we went up there, I stayed up there about three or four days, and it was cold, snow on the ground.…
Wait, wait, it was outside Jackson?
